current.summary: What remains of the attic is the raised ledge above the daybed in the lounge, with the lit recesses and the small attic window. Plan: tile it in the grey floor tile and add a guard rail (lounge jobs 1 and 2); later it becomes a second reading nook / chill-out area. Sitting height only — cushions, not standing.
issues: Builder to confirm the ledge can carry people

target.concept: A calm, light Mediterranean reading loft on the ledge: warm white walls and recesses, books on simple pale-oak shelves in the back recesses, natural linen and jute underfoot, a few terracotta and cream pieces. Chosen by Steph (Nov 2026) as a mix of two inspiration renders: the white and natural colours of 'Calm Mediterranean' with the bookshelf recesses of 'Little library'.

target.renderPrompt:
Edit this photo of a room in our house. Keep the exact camera angle and keep all the architecture exactly as it is: dark chestnut beams, the white walls, the raised ledge with its row of recesses under the old beam stubs, the small window with green shutters, the arched doorway, the daybed niche below. Do not add, move or remove anything structural. Remove all clutter: the cardboard box, the plaster patches, loose cables and the blue tape.

Changes to make:
- The ledge tiled in large light-grey floor tiles, with a slim matt-black iron guard rail with vertical bars along its edge.
- Walls and recesses evenly painted warm white.
- Each back recess fitted with simple pale natural-oak shelves filled with books, a few cream and terracotta ceramics and a candle, lit by the existing wall lights.
- On the ledge: natural undyed linen floor cushions and a low linen futon, a jute rug, a rattan basket of throws, one terracotta pot with a small olive tree, a linen throw over the rail. Light, airy and simple, no strong colours.
- Keep the gilt mirror, the brass chandelier and the daybed niche below.

Style: photorealistic interior photograph, natural light plus warm 2700K lamps, no people, no text or labels.
